speaker: Doctor
text:

You also noted low Apgar scores and worsening lethargy with a tonic seizure. Given the history of maternal infection and preterm birth, we must specifically test for Group B Streptococcus and Listeria sepsis, as well as evaluate for necrotizing enterocolitis.
